about: Now That's What I Call is a blank parody of the cover of the long-running "Now That's What I Call Music!" compilation albums: a giant yellow and pink "NOW" logo, the "THAT'S WHAT I CALL" banner underneath, and a white panel below where the word "Music" would normally go, all against a bright rainbow burst. Filling in that panel turns anything into a cheesy greatest-hits collection, which makes it great for roasting repetitive things.
usage:
There is one box, in the white panel under the banner. Write what the compilation is a collection of, and add a ridiculous volume number for extra effect.

It suits anything that keeps coming back: excuses, meetings, error messages, reboots, your dad's jokes. The higher the volume number, the funnier the implication that this has happened many times before.
aka: Now That's What I Call Music
Now That's What I Call Meme
